releaseSource.title: Autodesk Inventor 2027.2 what's new - Design & Manufacturing

calls.name: iProperties.ValueInDoc
calls.evidence: The Inventor 2014 help lists iProperties.ValueInDoc under deprecated functions, saying it still works in a rule but iProperties.Value is preferred.
calls.sourceQuote: the iProperties.Value function is preferred instead of these older functions.
calls.note: The source is from the 2014 help, not 2027.2, but it is the only documentation here that describes this call, and it marks the call deprecated.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference iProperties.ValueInDoc Inventor 2027.2

calls.name: ThisDoc.Document
calls.evidence: The Advanced API Functions Reference documents ThisDoc.Document as the way to get the document in which the current rule is stored, as an Inventor.Document object, and it is not marked deprecated.
calls.note: Only the older syntax iLogicVb.RuleDocument is mentioned as an alternative; ThisDoc.Document is the documented current form.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference ThisDoc.Document Inventor 2027.2

calls.name: MessageBox.Show
calls.evidence: The Inventor 2024 and 2025 iLogic help pages describe MessageBox.Show as the base function for showing a message box in rules, with no deprecation or removal notice, but they do not cover release 2027.2.
calls.sourceQuote: Acts as the base for the Message Box functions in iLogic. Use this function to show a message box.
calls.note: Documented as available in the 2024 and 2025 docs with no deprecation, though the provided docs predate 2027.2.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference MessageBox.Show Inventor 2027.2
